title: Read-only review health and Work handoff

intent.user: Builder maintaining a product in ChatGPT Work
intent.problem: A green push review can hide a missing schedule or stale installed copy
intent.outcome: See current evidence and recover product work without silent changes
non_goals: No remote repairs or automatic skill overwrite

sources.statement: User asked to work through each of the four proposed steps one by one.

requirements.statement: Distinguish scheduled execution from push/manual and current-main review with complete fresh target-bound evidence.

criteria.statement: Distinguish scheduled execution from push/manual and current-main review with complete fresh target-bound evidence.

requirements.statement: Require review job, receipt-validation step and artifact metadata; preserve waiting, missed, failed and unverified states.

criteria.statement: Require review job, receipt-validation step and artifact metadata; preserve waiting, missed, failed and unverified states.

requirements.statement: Check explicit installed bundle identity and versions without writes; preserve recoverable project intent.

criteria.statement: Check explicit installed bundle identity and versions without writes; preserve recoverable project intent.

assumptions.statement: Spec Loop itself is the product for this bounded technical feature cycle.
assumptions.basis: User approved sequential work; no separate application was supplied. Human pilot remains separate.

tasks.title: Read-only review health and Work handoff

checks.procedure: Inspect source package and Work bundle exports; record actual local module release scope and artifact hash.
Run against live GitHub MCP observations and the explicit installed bundle; resume native context. Record technical results and missing human outcome.
Observe a real builder use review health in a new Work conversation and provide feedback. Keep open without human participation.

product_review.reason: Review health is a bounded technical feature in the Work pilot, not human acceptance.
